people.name: Chris Butler (ice hockey)
people.extract: Chris Butler is an American former professional ice hockey defenseman who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Buffalo Sabres, Calgary Flames and hometown club, St. Louis Blues. Butler was a fourth round selection of the Sabres, chosen 96th overall at the 2005 NHL entry draft. He then played three seasons at the University of Denver before turning professional in 2008.
highlights: American former professional ice hockey defenseman.
Played in NHL with Sabres, Flames, St. Louis Blues.
Fourth round selection of Sabres in 2005 NHL draft.

people.name: Harry Saltzman
people.extract: Herschel "Harry" Saltzman was a Canadian theatre and film producer. He is best remembered for co-producing the first nine of the James Bond film series with Albert R. Broccoli. Apart from a ten-year stint living in St. Petersburg, Florida, he lived most of his life in Denham, Buckinghamshire, England.
highlights: Co-produced first nine James Bond film series.
Lived most of his life in Denham, England.
